query_text: what is the max amount you can collect for unemployment in mass

action.query: Massachusetts unemployment maximum weekly benefit amount 2026 dependency allowance
queries: Massachusetts unemployment maximum weekly benefit amount 2026 dependency allowance

content.text:
In **Massachusetts**, the current **maximum unemployment benefit is $1,105 per week** for regular UI claims, as of **October 5, 2025**. Benefits are generally about **50% of your average weekly wage**, capped at that amount. ([mass.gov](https://www.mass.gov/info-details/how-unemployment-insurance-benefits-are-determined?utm_source=openai))

You may also get a **dependency allowance of $25 per dependent child per week**, if you’re the main support for the child. Massachusetts says regular unemployment benefits can last up to **30 weeks**, so the maximum base amount could be up to:

**$1,105 × 30 weeks = $33,150**  
**plus any eligible dependency allowance.** ([mass.gov](https://www.mass.gov/info-details/how-unemployment-insurance-benefits-are-determined?utm_source=openai))

Note: PFML has a different maximum, so don’t confuse that with unemployment.
